tableLines.line: 👂 Overheard — Tanisha (to Adwoa): "the man in his 50s, the veterinarian's story has a fresh coat of paint." Tanisha taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Hokkaido, Japan. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
📓 Journal: Alejandra taught the woman in her 60s Gossip Network.
📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Aki speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You accept Thornfield's food — 2,755 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Aisha clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Mei.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.

🍲 The shared granary opens: 5,000 kcal for every fire of the realm, no strings. Thornfield, Stonebridge, The Red Table count it — and remember who fed them first. (Trust +10 with each.)

◈ SYSTEM: "46. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
◈ SYSTEM: "Oh. OH. Do you feel that? That's the whole PLANET leaning in. ...There's a table, little fires. A big one. Far away. And it is LOOKING at you. Give it a season worth judging."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,000 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."

🗣️ Tanisha to Ruth, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

🌙 Watchers at the south treeline see torchlight moving in The Red Table's camp — and it going dark. Whatever was coming, the doubled watch turned it. The night stays quiet, and everyone at the fire understands why.
📓 Codex: Commons raid from The Red Table turned back by the doubled watch — cooldown holds.
Riders from The Red Table: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
🌪️ THE FINALE struck The Red Table in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.
Word with the traders: The Red Table door is clear again. Whatever had them, let go.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/11/7), with 4 wave-4 and 3 wave-5 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 7 · Forage 16 · Craft 11 · Talk 13 · Explore 22)
◈ For a full seat, the ledger still wants: no capstone deed delivered (military tribute, trade charter, or feast embassy).
The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.
